adaptations: ASDisplayNode/NavigationContainer replaced with a window-sibling UIKit overlay bound to the exact Zoen mounted composer.

Original pinned GlassBackground, LiquidLens, TabSelectionRecognizer and scoped rendering dependencies run inside the Expo module; original category TGS payloads and PDF/PNG glyphs are retained with per-file provenance.

The category interaction scroll surface is a sibling above the two visual lens item containers, matching AttachmentPanel:2671-2687. Photos, durable review and standalone entry use the same native gallery.
Native selection, caption and explicitly requested Edit/Send remain bounded by the existing account/destination owner and encrypted journal CAS; no second durable gallery store is introduced.
remaining: Complete File/Audio child controllers, recent-file indexing/search/scan and supported attachment categories.

Side-by-side pixel and animation comparison, physical keyboard/camera/audio lifecycle, iCloud, accessibility, rotation and performance qualification remain incomplete. Integrated Simulator journeys and builds prove only the recorded subset.
